user.title: Lyding Strike
user.description: Adds the Lyding Strike family display to the sidebar (you can rename it in its Settings). Family members, calendars, chores, meals, lists and photos are all managed from inside the panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Lyding Strike is already set up.

init.title: Settings PIN
init.description: {status} Tick the box and submit to remove the settings PIN, for example if it was forgotten. Anyone can then set a new PIN from the display's Settings.
